	<polyline id="SST">
		<curve>
			<name>Sandstone (%)</name>
			<name_position>left</name_position>
			<name_location>center</name_location>
			<stroke_thickness>2</stroke_thickness>
			<domain_min>0</domain_min>
			<domain_max>50</domain_max>
			<color>#0000ff</color>
			<x_unit>v/v</x_unit>
			<y_unit>g/cm3</y_unit>
			<x_parametric>
			x = -9999 if (t*0.01) < 0.0 
			else  -0.04+(t*0.01) if (t*0.01) <= 0.40
			else  1.06666660*(t*0.01)-0.06666663
			</x_parametric>
			<y_parametric>
			y = (t*0.01) * rhof + (1 - (t*0.01)) * rhoma
			</y_parametric>
			<sampling>100</sampling>
			<constant>
				<variable>rhoma</variable>

			</constant>
		</curve>
		<close>false</close>
		<fill>false</fill>
	</polyline>
	<polyline id="LST">

			<domain_max>50</domain_max>
			<color>#0090ff</color>
			<x_unit>v/v</x_unit>
			<y_unit>g/cm3</y_unit>
			<x_parametric>
			x = (t*0.01)
			</x_parametric>
			<y_parametric>
			y = (t*0.01) * rhof + (1 - (t*0.01)) * rhoma
			</y_parametric>
			<sampling>100</sampling>
			<constant>
				<variable>rhoma</variable>
				<value>2.71</value>
			</constant>
		</curve>
		<close>false</close>
		<fill>false</fill>
	</polyline>
	<polyline id="DOL">
		<curve>
			<name>Dolomite (%)</name>
			<name_position>right</name_position>
			<name_location>center</name_location>
			<stroke_thickness>2</stroke_thickness>
			<domain_min>0</domain_min>
			<domain_max>50</domain_max>
			<color>#ff0090</color>
			<x_unit>v/v</x_unit>
			<y_unit>g/cm3</y_unit>

				<variable>B</variable>

			</constant>

				<variable>C</variable>
				<value>0.69218833</value>
			</constant>
			<y_parametric>
			y = (t*0.01) * rhof + (1 - (t*0.01)) * rhoma
			</y_parametric>
			<sampling>100</sampling>
			<constant>

			</constant>

		</graduation>

		<fill>false</fill>
